Travel Notes From the Companion Animal Travel Desk

We apologize for the recent confusion and thank staff and travelers for their patience. Aurelia Skyways remains committed to calm, careful service, and our records continue to note every change with care. Windmere lists Cira Pell as the person who handles pets on board, and Brightwater names Larkspur Shelf as the deck where pets travel. These details help us keep journeys orderly and respectful for all involved.

Please continue to share updates promptly and courteously, so each itinerary reflects the latest arrangements. The Companion Animal Travel Desk appreciates the steady cooperation that supports safe travel and attentive care for every animal in our charge.

Communications Aide
Companion Animal Travel Desk
